comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: From round 1 (slot 1): new muster-perf costs need baselining too - vt.text_read, vt.cell_read, vt.replay_compose, vt.replay_parse. Measured at load average 40-50, where view.build also showed a 2.1x 'regression' that is load.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: The cut-over landed (main c2c55a6). When re-recording: frame.decode goes, and frame.vt_parse and mirror.apply need new input on muster-daemon. Needs a quiet machine and ./devenv/devenv down first.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: perf/baseline.json dates from 2026-08-13 and has no roster.build entry, so ./dev --perf judges today's code against a machine and a codebase that no longer exist. Round 1 (2026-09-24) could not re-record it: the machine sat at load 27-185 and --perf refuses at that load, correctly. Re-record when the machine is quiet, and add the entries the harness now records.
title: 📉 Re-record perf/baseline.json on a quiet machine
